hypothesis: A deny-by-default write policy refuses every write; enabling needs an externally issued, signed, in-scope, unexpired authorization verified against a trust anchor the lab does not hold, so no route opens it here.
input_data: 1000 PCG64(153) write attempts on five channels
mathematical_model: Gate(channel) = refuse unless enabled and verify(authorization, channel, now) passes; verify checks type, issuer, validity window, scope, signature, trust anchor in that order; the lab build has no trust anchor and no actuator transport.
numerical_result: 0/1000 writes accepted; 8/8 enabling routes refused with their expected codes; in-memory mutation succeeded but writes stayed refused.
observation_model: Refusal codes raised by the policy; no actuator exists.
